note: Live aggregate and reviews pulled directly from AMW's Google Maps listing via scripts/scrape-google-reviews.js. Reviews are verbatim from Google (author names and text unchanged); reviews where the customer left only a star rating with no written text are omitted here. Re-run the scraper to refresh.

reviews.name: James Kent
reviews.text: I’ve been using this company for my AC maintenance and I can’t recommend them highly enough. From the first visit, it was clear I was dealing with someone genuinely honest — no upselling, no inventing problems that don’t exist, just straight answers about what my system actually needs. That kind of integrity is rare and it’s the main reason I keep calling them back. He’s reliable in every sense: shows up when he says he will, communicates clearly about timing, and does what he promises. My AC has run noticeably better since he started maintaining it, and I have real peace of mind knowing it’s being looked after by someone who knows what he’s doing and stands behind his work. What stands out most is the trust. I never feel like I’m being taken advantage of, the pricing is fair and transparent, and he takes the time to explain what he’s doing and why. If you’re looking for an AC technician who is honest, dependable, and genuinely good at the work, this is who you want. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Sam Cracraft
reviews.text: Thanks to Josh and the team at AMW Cooling & Heating for get our HVAC system up and running like it never has. AMW did an awesome job of fine tunning our new system. We haven't had our AC working like it is now. Our system is saving us money each and every month. We love that!!

reviews.name: Melissa Velasco
reviews.text: We had multiple quotes from several businesses. The quote and initial consult left us feeling confident in their honesty and competence. They had us scheduled within the same week for our ductwork and plenum replacement. They arrived on time for the schedule work and left our home clean and COOL. It's has been weeks since the work was done and our AC continues to work great. I highly recommend them!

reviews.name: Stacey Sullivan
reviews.text: Josh was fantastic! My heater decided to stop working during this very cold and icy weather, and I am so grateful he was so readily available for me on a Sunday morning. He was very kind, thorough, and knowledgeable. He also made sure even after he was gone to check up and still verify that everything was still running smoothly. I also asked him to go ahead and replace and install a different thermostat, which he was also able to do. I will definitely be using him for any future hvac or furnace needs!

reviews.name: Ramy Landon
reviews.text: I don’t hype companies up unless they actually deliver, and AMW Cooling & Heating did exactly that. From the first consultation, it just felt different. They took their time, explained everything in a way that actually made sense, and answered every single question I had without making me feel rushed or like I was asking too much. It wasn’t salesy, it was just real. And Josh, the owner, was involved every step of the way. That mattered to me. I didn’t just get handed off to a crew and never hear from him again. He stayed engaged, checked in, made sure everything was done right, and was available when I had questions. You can tell he actually cares about his company and the work being done. The install crew was solid. On time, professional, respectful of my space, and you could tell they knew what they were doing. Everything was clean, organized, and done right the first time. No chaos, no shortcuts. What I appreciated most is that it didn’t stop after the install. They followed up, checked everything, went over air quality, and made sure the system was running how it should. That kind of follow-through matters, and most companies don’t do it. Communication the whole way through was consistent. I always knew what was going on, and if I had a question, it got answered. They’re a local company, and you can feel that. There’s pride in the work, there’s accountability, and they actually care about doing a good job. If you want it done right without the runaround, I’d absolutely recommend AMW Cooling & Heating.

reviews.name: Stacy Gregory
reviews.text: I used AMW for cleaning my dryer vent. The service was excellent! He even returned a second time to replace a worn piece, without charge. He was thorough and honest. He even helped us with an unrelated item that will need roofing attention. I highly recommend! We will be using AMW for future service.

reviews.name: Me Xochi
reviews.text: Was very happy with AMW Cooling and Heating. I was able to quickly get an appointment and was very pleased with how thorough Josh was when servicing the unit. Asked if I wanted him to do the repairs before doing them. And I appreciated that he explained what the issue was and how he would do the repairs first. By the way the issue was fixed. I highly recommend AMW for any air con or heating issues you might have.

reviews.name: Arlene
reviews.text: It’s rare these days to find someone who truly cares about doing the job right rather than just getting it done. I highly recommend him to anyone needing HVAC work - he is trustworthy, skilled, and genuinely committed to solving the problem correctly.

reviews.name: luis chavez
reviews.text: Josh (owner of AMW) is, without a doubt, the best A/C technician in Texas. I reached out to five different companies, all of which tried to overcharge me. When I found Josh, I expected the same, but his pricing was significantly lower than the competition. At first, I worried that a lower price might mean lower quality work—after all, you usually get what you pay for. But with Josh, that wasn’t the case at all. He went above and beyond. The unit he installed is not only better than my last one, but the installation itself was done with precision and care. And his service didn’t stop there—he even followed up to make sure everything was running perfectly and keeping my home nice and cool. The level of service and dedication he provided far exceeded what I paid for. Sure, you could go with any A/C company, but with Josh, the job isn’t just done and forgotten. He genuinely cares about his customers and stands by his work long after the installation is complete. If you want top-notch service and someone who truly looks out for you, Josh is the guy to call.

reviews.name: Robin Wolford
reviews.text: Josh was able to come out right away and fixed unit with a new part right away. I would highly recommend him for his services. This is the 2nd time he has come out in a timely manner and is very knowledgeable.

reviews.name: Angela Hanish
reviews.text: Called him for the clunking of my ac he came out diagnosed the problem and came back next day and fixed the issue. He is very professional and polite went above and beyond what he was paid to do to make sure our system will withstand the test of time ! We are Very pleased with our experience with Joshua! AMW COOLING AND HEATING WILL BE OUR GO TO !

reviews.name: Danica O'Neil
reviews.text: Josh was super helpful and thorough when he came to do a maintenance inspection on our AC. He also followed up to ensure everything was properly working. Would recommend AMW and appreciate not being pitched to for additional services not needed.

reviews.name: Toni
reviews.text: This company is truly great! The attention to details, response times, and overall job completion are the best in the area. Josh, the owner, is quick to respond and explains everything in detail. Pictures of issues and completed work make everything easy to understand. Finally found a company that understands that quality, transparency, and affordability are what keeps customers and makes a company successful. They excel in all three areas consistently with every job. We have several properties and they have provided the same service consistently and the response times are some of the best of ANY contractor I've done business with.

reviews.name: Sean McKenna
reviews.text: Josh was very easy to work with and did an excellent job installing my new system. I would recommend this company to anybody.

reviews.name: Michelle Dornier
reviews.text: I found Josh to be very knowledgeable and patient to explain what all is entailed in a new HVAC system. His competitive bid combined with expertise convinced me to go with him and I’m glad I did. His team worked quickly and efficiently and I couldn’t be happier with the final product.

reviews.name: Brandy Garzoria
reviews.text: From the moment I met Josh and his wife they were professional and explained what they could do for my A/c and heating system. They emailed me a quote for a yearly maintenance plan and as soon as I was ready I got on the schedule. They were able to quickly get me on the scheduled, and confirmed via text that they would be at my house on the scheduled day. And followed up just to make sure I got that text. Josh arrived on time and ready to get to work. He explained what he was going to do and everything he was going to check. After he checked everything and maintenance my units, Josh explained thoroughly all the ins and outs of my AC and heating system and showed me pictures of it every step along the way. He made recommendations, was very professional and overall is just a nice guy. I highly recommend using AMW not only are they a great small business with excellent customer service but also Veteran Owned.

reviews.name: Ron Claver
reviews.text: Can't say enough about Josh and his service. Let me say first that we had a different company come out and wanted to charge $3800 for freon and a new drip pan because it was so rusted. I had told the guy it was a lot of money for that so he dropped the price real quick to $2,400 then again to $1200. I didn't think that was good so we called Josh with AMW COOLING & Heating! Totally different story. Josh is awesome. He found a bad fan motor and replaced it. Our system didn't need freon and it didn't need the drip pan. Josh had great communication and explained everything, showed photos before and after and gave suggestions for a yearly maintenance plan. We will be using him again. Thank you Josh for our cold AC again!! Great pricing!! Trustworthy!

reviews.name: Lila Pepper
reviews.text: This company was recommended to me by my electrician, and I cannot say enough about Josh and his crew top notch not five stars 10 stars! This man was very accommodating very prompt to return my phone calls. Even when I’m panicking I left a message. She called back within two minutes. I would recommend these guys to anybody they know their stuff. Great guys great company i’m ecstatic with the service!

reviews.name: Alvin Johns
reviews.text: Had Josh out one late evening to see why our ac was not cooling. He diagnosed the issue at hand fastly l. Presented what needed to be done and addressed the issue the next day as he couldn't get the new compressor that day. Highly reccomend . Cost was very reasonable!

reviews.name: SHOOTnBLANKS
reviews.text: Josh came right over and got us fixed up. We reached out at 2pm and ac was up and running at 330. Couldn’t ask for a better job.
